7.6.2.4 Deadline Supervision
[SWS_WdgM_CONSTR_06505] ⌈Deadline Supervision (WdgMDeadlineSupervi-
sion) of a Supervised Entity shall refer to Checkpoints (WdgMDeadlineStartRef,
WdgMDeadlineStopRef) that both belong to that Supervised Entity. In other words,
any of the referred Checkpoints shall not belong to other Supervised Entities.⌋
[SWS_WdgM_CONSTR_06512] ⌈Any ordered set of two Checkpoints shall not
have more than one Deadline Supervision (WdgMDeadlineSupervision) defined.⌋
caption: 7.6.2.4 Deadline Supervision
